_why: EVERY SKILL THE MODEL CAN SELECT IS ACCOUNTED FOR HERE, in one of three
buckets, and test/affordance-contract.test.mjs fails if any is missing from
all three.
prompt-usage-coverage.test.mjs already asserts that a selectable skill is
DOCUMENTED -- that the prompt says what its arguments are. That caught the
four skills the model was offered and could not use. It does not catch the
next failure along, which happened four times in one day:
swim_to shipped with a usage line and ZERO uses, because nothing in the
observation ever told the model it was in water.
Then the IN WATER line shipped without a destination, and the model asked
for zero-block crossings.
Tool equivalence surfaced the better pickaxe only inside a craft failure
the trapped bot never triggered; one bot sat entombed for ten hours
carrying the materials for its own rescue.
deposit_surplus was added to the milestone chain behind a rung requiring
15 blocks from home, when the median bot is 804 blocks away. Zero deposits.
Documented is not the same as discoverable. A capability the model cannot
see the applicability of is not shipped, it is merely present -- and its
silence looks exactly like the model choosing not to use it.
So: `contract` means an observation line names this skill's situation, and
the test renders a real prompt from a canonical eligible state to prove the
line appears -- plus an ineligible state to prove it does not always appear,
because a line that is always on carries no information.
`unconditional` means the skill applies in nearly any state, so there is
nothing situational to announce. The reason is required, and is the thing to
argue with.
`gap` means we KNOW the observation is missing. It is here so the silence is
recorded rather than mistaken for a finding, and so scripts/affordance-funnel.py
reports it every run instead of it becoming a thing everyone stopped seeing.
`eligibility` names a rule implemented in scripts/affordance-funnel.py, over
the LOGGED SNAPSHOT rather than the prompt -- deliberately a second,
independent source. If the snapshot says the bot was in water and the prompt
had no IN WATER line, that disagreement IS the bug, and it is only visible
because the two answers do not come from the same function.

contracts.why: Water is terrain, not a hazard. A bot in open water cannot know where land is; that is the definition of the situation.
A 7B model will not derive recipes from raw inventory. isolated-a-Alpha carried a stone pickaxe's ingredients for ten hours underground and asked for a wooden one.
Banked items survive death and carried ones do not, and nothing said so at the moment the bot was carrying a load worth banking.

unconditional.goto: Travel applies from any position; the destination comes from the task, not from an observation.
unconditional.explore: The affordance for not knowing where anything is. Always available by construction.
unconditional.gather: The primary verb. Every milestone in the ladder names something to gather.
unconditional.mine: Named directly by the milestone chain whenever ore is the objective.
unconditional.home: One fixed destination the bot always knows; KNOWN PLACES already carries it.
unconditional.status: A reporting verb with no world precondition.
unconditional.place: Its usage line covers when it works, and it has no situational trigger beyond carrying a placeable.

board.why: 13,734 board-arm decisions, usage line present, lectern within 8 blocks on 1,000 of them, and ZERO proposals. The model is told the verb exists and what it takes, and never chooses it. Nothing tells it WHEN -- that it is standing at the board, or that it has unfiled lessons worth filing.
board.watch: This is the third instance of the pattern that swim_to and deposit each demonstrated: the fix that worked both times was an observation line naming the situation, not more documentation.

build.why: ZERO proposals in roughly 200,000 logged decisions, before and after it was documented. Nothing ever tells the model a structure would help, and it is not clear what would.
build.watch: eligible is unmeasurable until a trigger exists; the funnel reports the zero so it stays visible.

withdraw.why: 25 proposals in roughly 200,000 decisions. Symmetric to deposit, and deposit only started moving once CARRYING named it. There is no observation for 'the chest you own has something you need'.
withdraw.watch: The CARRYING work is the template if this is ever worth doing.

eat.why: difficulty=peaceful means hunger does not deplete, so the eligible set may be genuinely empty. That is a real answer, not a defect -- but it has never been measured, and 'never applicable' and 'never announced' are indistinguishable from the outside.
eat.watch: If the funnel shows eligible>0 and prompted=0, this becomes a contract.

surface.why: The escape skill. Entombment is transient and self-resolving in the median case, and correlates POSITIVELY with productivity (r=+0.47), so an observation urging escape could easily make things worse.
surface.watch: Deliberately left alone. The exit contract in exit-contract.mjs handles the descent side.
